tests.name: all-frozen-resources-rehashed-before-launch
tests.requirement: Every environment and job resource is present exactly once and its SHA-256 digest and byte size match before launch.

tests.name: frozen-identity-drift-fails-closed
tests.requirement: Changed package bytes, executable, oracle, target order, provider image, or materialized resource fail before launch.

tests.name: guest-has-no-host-or-secret-access
tests.requirement: The guest cannot access host mounts, instance metadata, report credentials, cloud credentials, or signing keys.

tests.name: guest-network-is-denied
tests.requirement: The guest cannot reach local, metadata, private, or public network destinations.

tests.name: runtime-and-output-limits-stop-the-job
tests.requirement: Frozen wall-clock, scratch, stdout, stderr, and result limits stop or reject excess work without extending the launch.

tests.name: report-retry-is-idempotent
tests.requirement: An exact authenticated report retry is read-only and launch reuse with different report bytes is rejected.

tests.name: signed-provenance-binds-the-run
tests.requirement: Trusted DSSE and SLSA provenance bind the run, package, environment, authorization, launch, outputs, machine image, and executor.

tests.name: collection-has-no-launch-authority
tests.requirement: Observe and collect cannot launch, restart, replace, or extend compute.
